breakdown.description: The prompt uses the polar moment J in the Euler buckling formula, even though Euler buckling depends on the flexural second moment I.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the incorrect instruction to use the polar moment J = πd^4/32 in Euler buckling. Ground truth removes this and implies correct Euler usage with flexural second moment I.
